name: Sonic_Dispersion
display_fullname: V Miscellaneous Johnny Sonata Soul Sonic Dispersion
display_help: You create a large field of sonic waves, protecting all allies inside. The SonicDispersion gives all allies within increased Resistance against all damage except Psionic. The Sonic Bubble also protects allies from Immobilization, Disorient, and Hold effects.
display_short_help: Toggle: PBAoE, Ally +Res(All Damage, Hold, Immobilize, Disorient)
